text: Workgroup（工作群）是 DSH web 侧边栏插件，为主代理和子代理提供实时工作概览。它注册为 dsh-better-sidebar 的单页签，并结合会话与后台任务状态更新成员卡片和活动时间线。用户可以查看成员当前工具、最近活动、模型路由、任务进度、等待回应状态和预计剩余时间，也能展开细节并打开子代理会话。页面空闲或隐藏时停止高频轮询；使用前需安装 dsh-better-sidebar，不需要额外密钥或账号。

Workgroup is a DSH web sidebar tab for live activity across agents and background jobs. It shows current tools, recent events, progress, model routes, waits for input, and estimated time remaining. Expand a member or open its session. Requires dsh-better-sidebar; no extra key is needed.
我想在侧边栏同时看到主代理和所有子代理的运行状态。
能不能把后台任务显示在发起它的成员下面？
我需要知道每个子代理现在在用什么工具、做到哪一步。
让 DSH 按本机历史运行时长估算子代理还要多久。
哪些成员正在等我回答问题或批准操作？
我想看代理活动和后台任务进度组成的一条时间线。
Show me which agents are working and what each one is doing.
Can I see background jobs grouped under the agent that started them?
Workgroup 的成员状态：在右侧工作群页签中查看主代理及其子代理的运行状态、当前活动和最近文本；等待提问或审批的成员会显示等待标记。
Workgroup 的后台任务与时间线：订阅整棵会话树的任务列表，将任务折叠到所属成员，并记录任务开始、进度和结束事件。
Workgroup 的剩余时间估算：面板根据浏览器保存的子代理完成时长中位数估算剩余时间，没有历史数据时使用三分钟的经验值。
Workgroup 的子代理会话跳转：点击成员行可打开对应子代理会话，优先调用工作区的 openSession，并提供侧边栏标签回退方式。
Workgroup 的按需实时刷新：成员或任务运行时每两秒更新活动数据；面板隐藏或页面切到后台时会停止轮询，空闲时无需持续请求。
Workgroup 使用前须知：子代理开始时间和本机完成时长会写入浏览器 localStorage，供刷新后延续计时和估算；时间线数据则保留在内存中。

A right-sidebar tab for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) that shows **who is working right now, what each agent is doing, and how long the rest will probably take** — as a live group chat, not a static log.

dsh-group-tab README · dsh-group-tab — Workgroup：*Live: members, their current tool, per-member ETA, and who is waiting on you — recording of the real tab.*

Registered as a tab of [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) (the sidebar plugin that exposes the tab registry other plugins register into).

dsh-group-tab README · Why：When a main agent delegates to three subagents and starts two background jobs, DSH's conversation view tells you about one of them. You end up opening four sessions to answer "is anything stuck?".

This tab answers it in one place:

dsh-group-tab README · Why：- one card per member (main agent + every subagent in the tree), with the tool it is running right now
- a per-member ETA, from **this machine's own** finished runs (median of the last 20), clearly labelled when no history exists yet
- background jobs folded onto the member that owns them
- a merged timeline: started / tool switch / message / job progress / finished — newest at the bottom
- the model each member is dispatching on (`provider / model`)
- members waiting on **you** (a question or an approval) are pinned to the top with a red badge, a header count, and an optional chime when a subagent finishes

dsh-group-tab README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar   # peer: the tab host
```

Then this plugin, either from npm (once published) or straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-group-tab                              # npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:llCCII/dsh-group-tab                # GitHub, no npm needed
```

dsh-group-tab README · Install：Then open the right sidebar and pick **Workgroup** from the `＋` menu (it sits next to Tasks). It opens itself once per page load for the active session, and once per session as soon as delegated work starts; close it and it stops doing that for the rest of the page.

dsh-group-tab README · How it reads data：| Source | Transport | What it gives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sessions` client service | subscription (event-driven) | who exists, who is running, titles, lineage |
| `jobs` client service | subscription (event-driven) | background task rosters per session |
| `POST /sidebar/api/subagents.live` | poll, **only while something runs** | current tool + latest text per member |
| `POST /sidebar/api/git.models` | one call per member, 30 s cache | the model route a member is using |

dsh-group-tab README · How it reads data：**Idle costs nothing.** The 2 s fold poll and the 1 s clock tick only exist while at least one member or job is running, and they stop when the page is hidden (`visibilitychange`). An idle panel issues zero requests; a member starting to run flips the session list, which wakes the poll back up. The footer says `LIVE · 2s` while working and `LIVE · idle, no polling` when not.

dsh-group-tab README · Notes：- **No host half, no files.** The plugin owns no route and no markdown file; the panel is derived from live events, so it can never show stale state.
- **No markdown file** is written per turn; the timeline lives in memory (200 entries) and per-member start times in `localStorage` so a page refresh does not restart the clock.
- The chime is Web Audio (no asset), and the bell button in the header mutes it.
- The UI is Chinese or English from the browser language (`zh*` → Chinese, everything else → English).

dsh-group-tab README · Develop：```sh
npm test          # offline harness: fake React + fake host, real bundle
```

`test/render-check.mjs` runs the real `lib/client.js` against a fake React, fake DOM and fake host data, then asserts the rendered text: roster, ETA, model route, timeline diffing, awaiting pinning, and that an idle panel stops polling. `test/i18n-check.mjs` asserts the English dictionary is picked up.

dsh-group-tab README · Publishing checklist：- [ ] add `repository` / `homepage` to `package.json`
- [ ] `npm publish` (the package is already public-ready: no `private`, `files` list, MIT)
- [ ] tag a release and keep `preview/*.png` in sync

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）右侧栏加一个 tab：**谁在干活、每个人现在做到哪、大概还要多久**，用群聊的形态实时呈现，而不是一份静态日志。

*真界面录制：成员、当前工具、各自 ETA、谁在等你。*

它注册在 [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) 上（那个插件对外提供 tab 注册点，第三方 tab 都走它）。

dsh-group-tab README · 为什么：主代理派了三个子代理、又起了两个后台任务时，DSH 的会话视图只讲其中一个；想知道「有没有东西卡住」得开四个会话。

这个 tab 一个地方回答：

- 每个成员一张卡（主代理 + 树里所有子代理），显示**此刻正在跑的 tool**
- 每个成员的 ETA，按**本机自己**的历史完工时长算（最近 20 次取中位），没有历史时明确标注是按经验值估的
- 后台任务折叠到发起它的成员身上
- 一条合并的时间线：开始干活 / 换工具 / 说话 / 任务进度 / 收工，最新的在最下面
- 每个成员实际在用的模型（`provider / model`）
- **在等你**（提问或审批）的成员置顶 + 红色角标 + 头部计数；子代理收工可选提示音

dsh-group-tab README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar   # 必需：tab 宿主
```

再装本插件，npm 或直接从 GitHub 二选一：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-group-tab                              # npm（发布后）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:llCCII/dsh-group-tab                # 直接走 GitHub，不需要 npm
```

然后右侧栏 `＋` 菜单里选 **工作群**（和「任务管理」并列）。每次页面加载会在当前会话自动打开一次；一旦有派活，会按会话自动打开一次；你手动关掉后本页不再抢开（手动再打开即恢复）。

dsh-group-tab README · 数据来源：| 来源 | 方式 | 拿到什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sessions` 客户端服务 | 订阅（事件驱动） | 有哪些会话、谁在跑、标题、父子关系 |
| `jobs` 客户端服务 | 订阅（事件驱动） | 每个会话的后台任务清单 |
| `POST /sidebar/api/subagents.live` | 轮询，**只在有人跑时** | 每个成员当前工具 + 最后一句 |
| `POST /sidebar/api/git.models` | 每成员一次，30 秒缓存 | 成员实际用的模型路由 |

**空闲不花钱。** 2 秒轮询和 1 秒时钟只在「至少有一个成员或后台任务在跑」时存在；页面切到后台（`visibilitychange`）也会停。空闲面板零请求 —— 有人开始跑时，会话列表的事件会把它唤醒。页脚写着 `LIVE · 2s`（在跑）或 `LIVE · 空闲不轮询`。

dsh-group-tab README · 说明：- **没有宿主端（host）逻辑、不落文件**：面板完全由实时事件推导，不会显示过期状态。
- 时间线只存在内存里（上限 200 条），每个成员的起始时间写 `localStorage`，刷新页面不会把计时清零。
- 提示音用 Web Audio 现场合成（无音频资源），头部铃铛按钮可静音。
- 界面语言跟浏览器走（`zh*` 中文，其他英文）。

dsh-group-tab README · 开发：```sh
npm test          # 离线 harness：假 React + 假宿主，跑真 bundle
```

`test/render-check.mjs` 用真实 `lib/client.js` + 假 React/假 DOM/假宿主数据跑渲染，然后断言渲染出的文本：成员、ETA、模型、时间线去重、置顶、以及空闲时确实不再轮询。`test/i18n-check.mjs` 断言英文词条被选中。

dsh-group-tab README · 发布前清单：- [ ] 在 `package.json` 补 `repository` / `homepage`
- [ ] `npm publish`（已经是可发布状态：去掉了 `private`、给了 `files`、MIT）
- [ ] 打 tag 发版，`preview/*.png` 同步更新
